Yard, and the
compressive
strength was found

applicable
standards. Based on
the test results, the
customer was
reassured and
agreed to proceed
with using the
material.

At this stage, no
replacement is
required, as the
damaged quantity is
very limited and the
material has already
been used by the
customer without
any reported issues.
Resolved
- Positive

AHMED JAFFAR
ALORAIBI
JAFFAR AL-TAAN
Contractor
1OOR172855
Product
PRODUCTION
TOOBLI
8" WHITE
BLOCKS
Customer Name:
Husain Ahmed
Location: Toobli
Product: 8" White
Block  600 pcs
 Site has been
visited and the
customer mentioned
that some blocks
were cracked and
damaged.
After checking the
damage happened
during loading and
unloading.
Around 42 blocks
are damaged.
The customer is
rquesting to replace
the blocks with
sandwich block
Resolved
- Positive
He is satisfied
now..
Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

 Site has been

Around 42 blocks
are damaged.
The customer is
rquesting to replace

Resolved

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

 Site has been

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.

 Site has been

Resolved

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.

 Site has been

rquesting to replace

Resolved

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

failure in the

Analysis
 Comparison:

"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit

crane uses a
clamping
mechanism

damage to the
product.

Solutions

further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:

crane
attachment to

wooden pallet
itself rather

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

 Site has been

that some blocks
were cracked and
damaged.
After checking the
damage happened
during loading and
unloading.
Around 42 blocks
are damaged.
The customer is
rquesting to replace
the blocks with
sandwich block
Resolved
- Positive

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

 Site has been

damage happened
during loading and
unloading.
Around 42 blocks
are damaged.
The customer is
rquesting to replace
the blocks with
sandwich block
Resolved

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.

 Site has been

were cracked and

damage happened
during loading and
unloading.
Around 42 blocks
are damaged.
The customer is
rquesting to replace

Resolved

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

 Site has been

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Customer Name:

Product: 8" White
Block  600 pcs
 Site has been
visited and the
customer mentioned
that some blocks
were cracked and
damaged.
After checking the
damage happened
during loading and
unloading.
Around 42 blocks
are damaged.
The customer is
rquesting to replace
the blocks with
sandwich block
Resolved
- Positive
He is satisfied
now..
Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

 Site has been

damage happened

Around 42 blocks

The customer is
rquesting to replace

Resolved
- Positive

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Block  600 pcs
 Site has been
visited and the
customer mentioned
that some blocks
were cracked and
damaged.
After checking the
damage happened
during loading and
unloading.
Around 42 blocks
are damaged.
The customer is
rquesting to replace
the blocks with
sandwich block
Resolved
- Positive
He is satisfied
now..
Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.

 Site has been

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
NOT TRACKED

Cracks
Rgarding
white block
 Issue
Summary
My self ,Mr
Hussan
Nokhtha, Mr
sajit AND Mr
Mohanlal have
identified that
the current
lifting method
is causing
structural
failure in the
white blocks.
The blocks
have a
compressive
strength of
only 2 N,
making them a
highly
sensitive
product that
requires
specialized
handling.
 Root Cause
Analysis
 Comparison:
The
"Kingdom"
crane lifts the
blocks by
securing the
wooden
pallets they sit
on.
 Current
Failure: Our
crane uses a
clamping
mechanism
directly on the
blocks.
 Impact: The
pressure
exerted by the
clamps
exceeds the 2
N strength
limit, resulting
in immediate
damage to the
product.
 Proposed
Solutions
To prevent
further
damage, we
must treat
these as a
"Special
Product" and
implement
one of the
following
lifting
methods:
 Lifting Belts:
Use
specialized
lifting belts
positioned
underneath
the wooden
pallet to hoist
the entire unit.
 Pallet-Based
Clamping:
Adjust the
crane
attachment to
clamp the
wooden pallet
itself rather
than applying
pressure to
the blocks.
